name: Molybdenum
uses: Alloying element for steels and superalloys (strength and corrosion resistance at high temperature), catalysts, lubricants.
why_it_matters: A by-product of the porphyry copper mines of Chile and Peru, so its supply follows copper policy; China is the largest producer and a large buyer.
uses_source: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries (annual; uses as summarised there) and the registry notes; curated text, no figures
